senses.gloss: (archit.) a chamber or wing projecting from a building (with stairs from outside), balcony-chamber.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 92a:20">Ḥull. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>ב״כ דתותי א׳</he> a synagogue named ‘under the balcony’.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite>, end <he>כהדא א׳ דקרא וכ׳</he> like that tuber of cabbage, the larger the latter grows, the smaller gets the former.

senses.gloss: pl. אַפְתֵּי, only with רַמְשָׁא, spreading of night, nightfall.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:1:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, beg. 39ᵃ</cite>. Y. Bath. II, end, 13ᶜ.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:20">Koh. R. to II, 20</cite>.—<he>בפתי רמשא</he> = <he>בא׳ ר׳</he>. Y. Ab. Zar. l. c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>.
